# Vendored CANNJudge submission SDK

Source: `https://gitcode.com/cann/cann-learning-hub`.

Upstream revision: `62295ba213239a470952b43eb37938a53b883c5a`.
Source directory: `skills/cannjudge-submit/`.

`cannjudge_cli.py`, `project_files.py`, and `session_store.py` are copied
byte-for-byte from that revision. `LICENSE` is the upstream root license,
CANN Open Software License Agreement Version 2.0. Preserve it when distributing.

The persistent attempt wrapper is `../../cannjudge.py`; the vendored command's
direct submit and ranking presentation are not used by that wrapper.
